name: more_tracks_10
note: Ceiling 10.0 in and out of forest, and presence_floor 0.5 so every pixel with 3+ passes is credited, not only the top half of its tile - the 4/5/6 sweep found the ceiling alone only amplifies cells above the 50th percentile, so a route could not be pulled onto a lightly-used track at any price. The ceiling is the only thing that differs between more_tracks_5, _10, _15 and _25. Measured on the 30 review-flagged tours against the re-routed national baseline of 2026-09-18 (production on this set: 66.3% on tracked ground, exposure/km 3.558). Result: Coverage 83.0% (+25.3%) for exposure/km +21.3%. 18 of 30 moved more than 250 m. Nearly two points of coverage over 5.0, at four times the exposure cost.
